title: 2 Vintage Avon Anniversary Ceramic Plates 2nd And 5th w/Boxes +Certificates
descriptionText: Two vintage Avon anniversary plates, one for the 2nd anniversary and the other for the 5th, with their original boxes and certificates. These collectible ceramic plates feature a multicolor design in an art pottery production style, showcasing American culture from the late 20th century. Ideal for collectors or those celebrating milestones.
